summary: This note is a wiki infobox for Izzie Stevens, a character on the television series Grey's Anatomy, created by Shonda Rhimes and portrayed by Katherine Heigl. It lists her first and last appearances, full name, title, family, spouses and significant others, and religion. The note contains no narrative biography beyond these fields.
one_line: Izzie Stevens is a fictional M.D. character on the medical drama Grey's Anatomy, played by Katherine Heigl from 2005 to 2010.
key_facts: Izzie Stevens is a character on Grey's Anatomy, created by Shonda Rhimes.
Katherine Heigl portrays Dr. Izzie Stevens on Grey's Anatomy.
Izzie Stevens first appeared in the episode "A Hard Day's Night" (1.01) on March 27, 2005.
Izzie Stevens last appeared in the episode "I Like You So Much Better When You're Naked" (6.12) on January 21, 2010.
The full name of Izzie Stevens is Isobel Katherine Stevens.
Izzie Stevens holds the title M.D.
The mother of Izzie Stevens is Robbie Stevens.
The daughter of Izzie Stevens is Hannah Klein.
Izzie Stevens was divorced from Alex Karev, who is listed as her spouse.
Hank Denny Duquette was the fiancé of Izzie Stevens and is listed as deceased.
George O'Malley is listed as a significant other of Izzie Stevens and is deceased.
Alex Karev is listed as both a spouse (divorced) and a significant other of Izzie Stevens.
The religion listed for Izzie Stevens is Catholicism.
